# Dragify

> Dragify is an iPhone app that transforms a selfie into a drag queen look using AI face swap. Snap or upload a photo, pick a look pack, and get a polished drag transformation in seconds — then share it.

Dragify is made for anyone curious about drag: first-timers exploring a look, drag fans, and performers who want quick concept art. It runs on iOS and is free to download with optional in-app purchases and a subscription (Dragify Pro) that unlocks additional look packs.

## What it does
- AI drag face swap: turn a selfie into a drag queen portrait.
- Look packs: curated aesthetics (e.g. Canonical Queens, Euphoria // UV) to swap into.
- Instant reveal and one-tap sharing.
- On-device-friendly flow: capture a selfie, generate, reveal, share.

## Get the app
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dragify-drag-queen-face-swap/id6756401226

## Common questions
- Platform: iPhone (iOS). No Android or web app version.
- Price: free to download; optional in-app purchases and a Dragify Pro subscription.
- What you need: a selfie or portrait photo.
